featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 在 AI 监控中显示真实提供商额度，优先读取本机记录，支持 Codex、Claude statusLine、Cursor 月额度与 Grok。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Show verified provider quotas in AI monitoring, preferring local records and supporting Codex, Claude statusLine, Cursor monthly quotas and Grok.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 向认证终端同步提供商额度并支持主动查询，小组件可通过加密 HTTP 独立读取桌面摘要。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Sync provider quotas to authenticated terminals, support explicit queries, and let widgets fetch encrypted desktop summaries over HTTP.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 提供加密配对备份与恢复，展示稳定桌面身份并区分测试实例。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add encrypted pairing backup and recovery, expose stable desktop identity, and distinguish test instances.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 额度卡显示套餐标签、真实五小时及周／月窗口，并使用红黄绿进度条。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Show plan labels, actual five-hour and weekly/monthly windows, and red-yellow-green quota progress bars.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 设备发现服务失败后自动退避重试，并统一 Agent 显示名称。
bugFixes.en-US: Retry failed device advertising with bounded backoff and unify Agent display names.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 保留只有周额度的卡片，修复 JSONL 截尾、较新空记录及 Cursor 多行缓存导致本地窗口被丢弃的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Keep weekly-only cards and preserve local windows across truncated JSONL tails, newer empty records and multiple Cursor cache rows.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 隔离 curl 与 SQLite 的用户默认配置，拒绝外部程序失败退出，并让超时覆盖标准输入写入。
bugFixes.en-US: Ignore user curl and SQLite startup configuration, reject failed process exits, and apply timeouts to stdin writes.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复小于 1% 的百分数被错误放大为比例的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix percentages below 1% being incorrectly treated as fractional ratios.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增局域网终端配对与加密连接，同步今日 Token 用量、Hooks 状态及按需图片资源。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add LAN device pairing and encrypted connections for today's token usage, Hook status and on-demand image resources.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 客户端发起配对时自动显示全局弹窗，展示名称与连接地址，四位配对码明文输入并保留前导零。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Automatically show a global dialog for incoming pairing requests, with the reported name, connection address and visible four-digit code entry preserving leading zeros.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 终端设备页采用紧凑配图卡片，按认证上报区分手机与平板，并展示 iPhone 所属 Watch 的独立通信状态。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Use compact illustrated device cards, distinguish phones and tablets from authenticated reports, and show separate communication status for an iPhone's Watch.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增共用 Rust 配对与移动协议桥，双向认证成功且私有存储完成后才确认配对。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add shared Rust pairing and mobile protocol bridges, confirming pairing only after mutual authentication and successful private storage.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 图库支持 BMP 及静态、动态 WebP，保留透明度、动画延迟与循环次数。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Support BMP and static or animated WebP images while preserving transparency, frame timing and loop counts.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 校验 WebP 内部编码帧与容器尺寸，防止畸形图片绕过解码内存预算，并保留合法动画扩展块兼容性。
bugFixes.en-US: Validate encoded WebP frame dimensions against their containers to prevent malformed images from bypassing decode memory budgets, while preserving valid animation extension chunks.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 配对请求按独立票据处理取消、断开与过期，避免旧窗口或迟到回调影响新连接。
bugFixes.en-US: Bind pairing cancellation, disconnects and expiry to individual tickets so stale dialogs and late callbacks cannot affect a new connection.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐 Linux 应用目录元数据，供软件中心关联已安装应用、包身份与卸载入口。
bugFixes.en-US: Include Linux AppStream catalog metadata so software centers can associate installed applications with their packages and removal actions.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 统一原生启动与 X11 窗口状态处理，减少重复的宿主协议逻辑。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Unify native startup and X11 window-state handling to reduce duplicated platform logic.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Linux 自启状态读取与注册共用用户目录解析，避免 HOME 缺失时误判。
bugFixes.en-US: Use the same home-directory resolution for Linux autostart registration and status reads, including when HOME is absent.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复本机发布登记落后导致的版本门禁阻断，并完整保留后续待发变更。
bugFixes.en-US: Recover stale local release tracking without losing subsequent pending changes or bypassing version checks.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Windows、Linux 登录自启未静默隐藏主窗的问题，统一识别登录标记，并在托盘未就绪时有界等待与回退显示。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix Windows and Linux login launches showing the main window by recognizing the autostart marker consistently and waiting within a bounded deadline for tray availability before falling back to a visible window.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Linux X11/XWayland 主窗任务栏条目与托盘状态不同步的问题，重映射后重新申请隐藏条目，并在恢复入口丢失时恢复窗口。
bugFixes.en-US: Keep the Linux X11/XWayland main-window taskbar entry in sync with tray availability, reapply the hide request after remapping, and restore the window if its tray recovery entry disappears.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Linux 显窗请求失败后丢失恢复意图的问题，托盘不可用时继续重试，成功后停止重复显窗。
bugFixes.en-US: Preserve the Linux window recovery intent after a failed show request, retry while the tray is unavailable, and stop repeating show requests after success.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 同步 Harness 工程工具与规则，完善 GPUI 工程入口、依赖治理和 Linux 已验证能力索引。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Synchronize Harness engineering tools and rules, refining GPUI workflows, dependency governance and the index of verified Linux capabilities.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复跨机器发布后本机生命周期记录落后导致的版本门禁阻断；核验既有 tag、上下文和版本状态，并保留原记录。
bugFixes.en-US: Recover stale local lifecycle records after releases on another machine by verifying existing tags, contexts and version state while preserving the original records.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 本地打包之外的当次明确推送绑定精确提交与 tag，保留打包策略并逐项核对远端发布引用。
bugFixes.en-US: Bind explicitly requested pushes in addition to local packaging to the exact release commit and tag, preserving the packaging policy and verifying each remote release reference.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 将用量看板 Token 构成面板中的紧凑值和精确值统一左对齐，与指标标题保持一致。
bugFixes.en-US: Left-align compact and exact token values in the dashboard token breakdown panel to match their labels.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复Claude子Agent工具或API失败被误报为主任务错误，保留主Agent的真实错误与独立询问状态。
bugFixes.en-US: Prevent Claude subagent tool and API failures from being reported as main-task errors while preserving genuine main-agent failures and independent decision requests.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 补齐GPUI来源校验的分组补丁解析，并同步Linux知识库及当前工程计划。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Complete grouped GPUI patch verification and update Linux engineering knowledge and the current development plan.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复静态图片首次解码后空白，首帧无需鼠标操作、图库刷新或动画驱动。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix blank static images after initial decoding without requiring pointer input, gallery refresh or animation timers.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复Linux关闭主窗口时重复借用窗口，确保存在真实托盘入口时可隐藏并恢复。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix a reentrant window borrow when closing the Linux main window, preserving hide and restore through a real tray entry.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复GNOME找不到包内图标，实际生成512像素PNG并安装到标准hicolor目录。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix missing GNOME package icons by generating a real 512-pixel PNG in the standard hicolor directory.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 增加Linux GNU x64/ARM64原生及交叉构建，支持deb与tar.gz打包并校验最终资源。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add native and cross-architecture Linux GNU x64/ARM64 builds with deb and tar.gz packaging and final resource verification.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复桌宠先读取设置后Hooks启用配置未发布的问题，覆盖五种Agent的真实命令链路。
bugFixes.en-US: Publish enabled Agent settings after pet-first loads so Hooks work through the real command paths of all five Agents.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复X11/XWayland桌宠设置保存、悬浮置顶、尺寸锁定和鼠标穿透，异步确认后落盘并保留退出前意图。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix X11/XWayland pet preference persistence, topmost state, size locking and mouse passthrough; confirm native changes asynchronously and preserve shutdown intent.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐Linux窗口Logo和一致的桌面身份，修复Dock及任务栏图标缺失。
bugFixes.en-US: Provide the Linux window Logo and consistent desktop identity to restore Dock and taskbar icons.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 确认真实托盘恢复入口后才隐藏主窗，入口消失时恢复窗口。
bugFixes.en-US: Hide the main window only after confirming a real tray recovery entry, and restore it if that entry disappears.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐Linux系统通知，修复权限重试、关闭重开及退出时的迟到投递。
bugFixes.en-US: Implement Linux system notifications and fix late delivery after permission retry, disable/re-enable and shutdown.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复受限umask导致的Linux包权限错误，避免提权安装误操作root Rust工具链。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix Linux package permissions under restrictive umask and prevent elevated setup from modifying the root Rust toolchain.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 同步本地Harness的Linux打包能力及知识库，精确校验封存生成物和工程回归。
bugFixes.en-US: Synchronize local Harness Linux packaging capabilities and knowledge, with exact archived-generation verification and engineering regressions.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 托盘新增开机自启选项，勾选状态与系统设置同步。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add a launch-at-login option to the tray menu, reflecting the actual system setting.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 当天Token总量首次严格超过1B时通知一次，显示当前总量；跨日重新计数。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Notify once when daily tokens first exceed 1B, showing the current total and resetting for each new day.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增Hooks询问、错误与完成通知，并在Codex或WorkBuddy换肤实际成功、失败时提示结果。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add Hook decision, error and completion notifications, plus result notifications for successful or failed Codex and WorkBuddy skin changes.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复取消、中断或关闭会话被误报为完成，以及普通工具执行被误报为需要决策。
bugFixes.en-US: Prevent cancellations, interruptions and session closure from appearing as completion, and ordinary tool execution from appearing to require a decision.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复子Agent或无关并行工具解除主Agent询问；按工具调用与MCP澄清归属处理等待和回执。
bugFixes.en-US: Keep child agents and unrelated parallel tools from clearing the main agent decision state, correlating tool and MCP clarification requests with replies.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐Claude提问、OpenCode独立工具回调及决策回执，修正Grok、Gemini、Copilot、Qwen和Kimi事件映射。
bugFixes.en-US: Cover Claude questions, OpenCode native tool callbacks and decision replies, and correct Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Qwen and Kimi event mappings.

bugFixes.zh-CN: WorkBuddy和Hermes依据真实最终结果判断完成或失败；可恢复工具错误不再封死当前工作。
bugFixes.en-US: Use authoritative WorkBuddy and Hermes final outcomes for success or failure, and keep recoverable tool errors from retiring active work.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Codex和Grok的Stop允许同轮次继续；上游缺少确定成功信号时保守停发该事件的已完成通知。
bugFixes.en-US: Allow Codex and Grok to continue the same turn after Stop, and suppress its completion notification while upstream lacks a definitive success signal.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 通知状态独立于桌宠共享槽位，换肤结果由后台任务观察，离开页面不丢失已提交操作的结果。
bugFixes.en-US: Track notification state independently of shared pet slots and observe skin results in the background so leaving the page preserves submitted outcomes.
